name: Scalable Person Re-identification
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate person re-identification methods at large scale, assessing retrieval and identification performance.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) and rank-1 accuracy
reputation: Highly influential benchmark in the person re-identification community (e.g., Market-1501 / related large-scale re-id datasets) and widely used as a standard evaluation suite.
notes: Non-LLM, vision-only benchmark; prone to dataset bias and overfitting to gallery/probe splits, potential label noise; portions of the benchmark have become easier as methods and backbone architectures improve, leading to partial saturation on some metrics.
